author: MeggRM
quote:
My husband was so excited for this game and yet has been bored of it, I’ve watched him play, doing what seemed like errands non stop. He eventually opted to roam the map for fun and got bored again when all he ever encountered were pissed off NPC’s that wanted to start a fight. Nothing interesting ever happened. Also the physics are almost non existent, why can’t I crush cars with an excavator ect? 
I gave the controller back to my husband after an hour of playing but loved gta5 so much. 
Hopefully updates in the future will help improve the lacklustre feeling we are personally getting with this game.

author: MeggRM
quote: A visually stunning game that leaves a wonderful impression and makes you want more. Every new area brings a beautiful atmosphere!
